sentences.zh: 調宜尚羽，以致其平。

translations.literal: The mode should emphasize yu to restore balance.
translations.idiomatic: The mode should emphasize yu to restore balance.

sentences.zh: 閏月，禦明堂，闔左扉。

translations.literal: In an intercalary month, the Emperor presided at the Bright Hall and closed the left door.
translations.idiomatic: In an intercalary month the Emperor presided at the Bright Hall with the left door closed.

sentences.zh: 樂以其月之律。

translations.literal: Music used the pitch pipes of that month.
translations.idiomatic: The music followed that month's pitch pipes.

sentences.zh: 十一月，知永興軍席旦言：“太學、辟雍士人作樂，皆服士服，而外路諸生尚衣衤蘭襆，望下有司考議，為圖式以頒外郡。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Xi Dan, military commissioner of Yongxing Army, said: "When scholars of the Imperial Academy and the Imperial College perform music, they all wear scholar robes, yet students on the outer circuits still wear caps and orchid-colored headwraps. We hope the relevant offices will examine and deliberate, draw up a pattern, and distribute it to the outer prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Xi Dan, commissioner of Yongxing Army, memorialized: "Imperial Academy and Imperial College scholars all wear proper scholar dress when performing music, but students in the outer circuits still wear caps and orchid headwraps. We ask that the appropriate offices study the matter, establish a standard design, and issue it to the outer prefectures.

sentences.zh: 八年八月，宣和殿大學士蔡攸言：“九月二日，皇帝躬祀明堂，合用大樂。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the eighth year, Cai You, Grand Academician of the Xuanhe Hall, said: "On the second day of the ninth month the Emperor will personally sacrifice at the Bright Hall, and the great music should be used.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the eighth year Cai You, Grand Academician of the Xuanhe Hall, said: "On the second day of the ninth month the Emperor will personally sacrifice at the Bright Hall, and the great music ought to be employed.

sentences.zh: 按《樂書》：‘正聲得正氣則用之，中聲得中氣則用之。

translations.literal: According to the Music Treatise: 'When the correct tones obtain the proper qi, use them; when the central tones obtain the central qi, use them.
translations.idiomatic: According to the Music Treatise: 'When correct tones match the proper qi, use them; when central tones match the central qi, use them.

sentences.zh: ’自八月二十八日，已得秋分中氣，大饗之日當用中聲樂。

translations.literal: ' Since the twenty-eighth day of the eighth month the autumn equinox's central qi has already arrived, the day of the grand feast should use central-tone music.
translations.idiomatic: ' Since the autumn equinox's central qi had already arrived on the twenty-eighth day of the eighth month, the day of the grand feast ought to use central-tone music.

sentences.zh: 今看詳古之神瞽考中聲以定律，中聲謂黃鍾也，黃鍾即中聲，非別有一中氣之中聲也。

translations.literal: Upon careful review, the ancient blind music masters determined the central tone to establish pitch, and the central tone is called Huangzhong; Huangzhong is the central tone—there is no separate central tone within the central qi.
translations.idiomatic: On careful review, the ancient blind music masters fixed pitch by the central tone, and the central tone is Huangzhong. Huangzhong is the central tone; there is no other central tone apart from the central qi.

sentences.zh: 考閱前古，初無中、正兩樂。

translations.literal: Examining antiquity, there were originally no two separate musics of central and correct tones.
translations.idiomatic: Examination of antiquity shows there were originally no two separate musics of central and correct tones.

sentences.zh: 若以一黃鍾為正聲，又以一黃鍾為中聲，則黃鍾君聲，不當有二。

translations.literal: If one Huangzhong serves as the correct tone and another Huangzhong serves as the central tone, then Huangzhong, the sovereign tone, ought not to exist in duplicate.
translations.idiomatic: If one Huangzhong is made the correct tone and another Huangzhong the central tone, then Huangzhong—the sovereign tone—ought not to be duplicated.

sentences.zh: 況帝指起律。

translations.literal: Moreover, pitch is established from the Emperor's finger.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, pitch is established from the Emperor's finger.

sentences.zh: 均法一定，大呂居黃鍾之次，陰呂也，臣聲也。

translations.literal: Once the equalization method is fixed, Dalü follows Huangzhong; it is a yin pitch and a ministerial tone.
translations.idiomatic: Once the equalization method is fixed, Dalü follows Huangzhong; it is a yin pitch and a ministerial tone.

sentences.zh: 今減黃鍾三分，則入大呂律矣。

translations.literal: If Huangzhong is now reduced by one-third, it falls into the pitch of Dalü.
translations.idiomatic: If Huangzhong is reduced by one-third, it enters the pitch of Dalü.

sentences.zh: 易其名為黃鍾中聲，不唯紛更帝律，又以陰呂臣聲僭竊黃鍾之名。

translations.literal: Renaming it 'Huangzhong central tone' not only confounds the Emperor's pitch system, but also lets a yin pitch and ministerial tone usurp the name of Huangzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Renaming it 'Huangzhong central tone' not only confounds the Emperor's pitch system, but also lets a yin pitch and ministerial tone usurp Huangzhong's name.

sentences.zh: 若依《樂書》‘正聲得正氣則用之，中聲得中氣則用之’，是冬至祀天、夏至祭地，常不用正聲而用中聲也。

translations.literal: If one follows the Music Treatise—'When the correct tones obtain the proper qi, use them; when the central tones obtain the central qi, use them'—then at the winter solstice sacrifice to Heaven and the summer solstice sacrifice to Earth, the correct tones would regularly go unused while the central tones were used.
translations.idiomatic: If one follows the Music Treatise—'When correct tones match the proper qi, use them; when central tones match the central qi, use them'—then at the winter solstice sacrifice to Heaven and the summer solstice sacrifice to Earth, correct tones would regularly go unused while central tones were used.

sentences.zh: 以黃鍾為正聲，易大呂為中聲之黃鍾，是帝律所起，黃鍾常不用而大呂常用也。

translations.literal: Taking Huangzhong as the correct tone and replacing Dalü with a Huangzhong of central tone means that the pitch from which the Emperor's system begins—Huangzhong—is regularly unused while Dalü is regularly used.
translations.idiomatic: Taking Huangzhong as the correct tone and substituting Dalü for a Huangzhong of central tone means that Huangzhong—the pitch from which the Emperor's system begins—is regularly unused while Dalü is regularly used.

sentences.zh: 抑陽扶陰，退律進呂，為害斯大，無甚於此。

translations.literal: Suppressing yang and supporting yin, retreating from pitch pipes and advancing yin tones—the harm is immense, and nothing exceeds this.
translations.idiomatic: Suppressing yang and supporting yin, retreating from pitch pipes and advancing yin tones—the harm is immense, and nothing exceeds this.

sentences.zh: 今來宗祀明堂，緣八月中氣未過，而用中聲樂南呂為宮，則本律正聲皆不得預。

translations.literal: Now, for the ancestral sacrifice at the Bright Hall, because the eighth month's central qi has not yet passed, central-tone music is used with Nanlü as gong, and then none of the fundamental correct tones may participate.
translations.idiomatic: Now, for the ancestral sacrifice at the Bright Hall, because the eighth month's central qi has not yet passed, central-tone music is used with Nanlü as gong, and the fundamental correct tones cannot participate.

sentences.zh: 欲乞廢中聲之樂，一遵帝律，止用正聲，協和天人，刊正訛謬，著於《樂書》。

translations.literal: We beg to abolish central-tone music, follow the Emperor's pitch system in full, and use only correct tones, harmonizing Heaven and man, correcting errors, and recording this in the Music Treatise.
translations.idiomatic: We beg to abolish central-tone music, follow the Emperor's pitch system in full, use only correct tones, harmonize Heaven and man, correct the errors, and record this in the Music Treatise.

sentences.zh: ”詔可。

translations.literal: " The edict approved it.
translations.idiomatic: " The edict approved it.

sentences.zh: 攸又乞取已頒中聲樂在天下者。

translations.literal: You also requested that all central-tone music already distributed throughout the realm be recalled.
translations.idiomatic: You also requested that all central-tone music already distributed throughout the realm be recalled.

sentences.zh: 宣和元年四月，攸上書：

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Xuanhe, You submitted a memorial:
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the first year of Xuanhe, You submitted a memorial:

sentences.zh: 奉詔製造太、少二音登歌宮架，用於明堂，漸見就緒，乞報大晟府者凡八條：

translations.literal: By imperial order, great and small registers for the ascending song and palace orchestral stands, to be used at the Bright Hall, are gradually nearing completion. The eight items reported to the Great Sheng Prefecture are as follows:
translations.idiomatic: By imperial order, great and small registers for the ascending song and palace orchestral stands, to be used at the Bright Hall, are gradually nearing completion. The eight items reported to the Great Sheng Prefecture are as follows:

sentences.zh: 一，太、正、少鍾三等。

translations.literal: First, great, standard, and small bells in three grades.
translations.idiomatic: First, great, standard, and small bells in three grades.

sentences.zh: 舊制，編鍾、編磬各一十六枚，應鍾之外，增黃鍾、大呂、太簇、夾鍾四清聲。

translations.literal: Under the old system, the chime bells and chime stones each had sixteen pieces; beyond Yingzhong, four clear tones were added—Huangzhong, Dalü, Taicu, and Jiazhong.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old system, the chime bells and chime stones each had sixteen pieces; beyond Yingzhong, four clear tones were added—Huangzhong, Dalü, Taicu, and Jiazhong.

sentences.zh: 今既分太、少，則四清聲不當兼用，止以十二律正聲各為一架。

translations.literal: Now that great and small grades are separated, the four clear tones should not be used together; only the twelve correct tones of the pitch pipes, each forming one stand, should be used.
translations.idiomatic: Now that great and small grades are separated, the four clear tones should not be used together; only the twelve correct tones of the pitch pipes, each forming one stand, should be used.

sentences.zh: 其二，太、正、少琴三等。

translations.literal: Second, great, standard, and small zithers in three grades.
translations.idiomatic: Second, great, standard, and small zithers in three grades.

sentences.zh: 舊制、一、三、五、七、九弦凡五等。

translations.literal: Under the old system there were five grades of one, three, five, seven, and nine strings.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old system there were five grades of one, three, five, seven, and nine strings.

sentences.zh: 今來討論，並依《律書》所載，止用五弦。

translations.literal: After discussion, all are to follow what is recorded in the Pitch Treatise, using only five strings.
translations.idiomatic: After discussion, all are to follow what is recorded in the Pitch Treatise, using only five strings.

sentences.zh: 弦大者為宮而居中央，君也。

translations.literal: The largest string is gong and occupies the center—it is the sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: The largest string is gong and occupies the center—it is the sovereign.

sentences.zh: 商張右傍，其餘大小相次，不失其序，以為太、正、少之製，而十二律舉無遺音。

translations.literal: Shang extends to the right; the rest vary in size in proper order without losing sequence, forming the great, standard, and small design, so that none of the twelve pitch pipes lacks a note.
translations.idiomatic: Shang extends to the right; the rest vary in size in proper order without losing sequence, forming the great, standard, and small design, so that none of the twelve pitch pipes lacks a note.

sentences.zh: 其一、三、五、七、九弦，太、少樂內更不製造。

translations.literal: The one-, three-, five-, seven-, and nine-string zithers are no longer to be made within great and small music.
translations.idiomatic: The one-, three-, five-, seven-, and nine-string zithers are no longer to be made within great and small music.

sentences.zh: 其三，太、正、少籥三等。

translations.literal: Third, great, standard, and small yue flutes in three grades.
translations.idiomatic: Third, great, standard, and small yue flutes in three grades.

sentences.zh: 謹按《周官》籥章之職，龡以迎寒暑。

translations.literal: Respectfully according to the office of the Yue Master in the Rites of Zhou, who blew to welcome cold and heat.
translations.idiomatic: Respectfully according to the office of the Yue Master in the Rites of Zhou, who blew to welcome cold and heat.

sentences.zh: 王安石曰：“籥，三孔，律呂於是乎生，而其器不行於世久矣。

translations.literal: Wang Anshi said: "The yue has three holes; pitch pipes and yin-yang tones were born from it, yet the instrument has long ceased to be used in the world.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi said: "The yue has three holes; pitch pipes and yin-yang tones were born from it, yet the instrument has long ceased to be used in the world.

sentences.zh: 近得古籥，嚐以頒行。

translations.literal: Recently an ancient yue was obtained and was once distributed for use.
translations.idiomatic: Recently an ancient yue was obtained and was once distributed for use.

sentences.zh: ”今如《爾雅》所載，製造太、正、少三等，用為樂本，設於眾管之前。

translations.literal: " Now, as recorded in the Erya, great, standard, and small grades are to be made, used as the foundation of music, and placed before the multitude of pipes.
translations.idiomatic: " Now, as recorded in the Erya, great, standard, and small grades are to be made, used as the foundation of music, and placed before the multitude of pipes.

sentences.zh: 其四，太正少笛、塤、篪、簫各三等。

translations.literal: Fourth, great, standard, and small transverse flutes, ocarinas, chi flutes, and xiao pipes, each in three grades.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, great, standard, and small transverse flutes, ocarinas, chi flutes, and xiao pipes, each in three grades.

sentences.zh: 舊制，簫一十六管，如鍾磬之製，有四清聲。

translations.literal: Under the old system, the xiao had sixteen pipes, like the chime-bell and chime-stone design, with four clear tones.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old system, the xiao had sixteen pipes, like the chime-bell and chime-stone design, with four clear tones.

sentences.zh: 今既分太、少，其四清聲亦不合兼用，止用十二管。

translations.literal: Now that great and small grades are separated, the four clear tones likewise should not be used together; only twelve pipes are to be used.
translations.idiomatic: Now that great and small grades are separated, the four clear tones likewise should not be used together; only twelve pipes are to be used.

sentences.zh: 其五，大晟匏有三色：一曰七星，二曰九星，三曰閏餘，莫見古製。

translations.literal: Fifth, the Great Sheng gourd pipes had three types: one called Seven Stars, one called Nine Stars, and one called Intercalary Remainder—none of which appear in ancient institutions.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth, the Great Sheng gourd pipes had three types: one called Seven Stars, one called Nine Stars, and one called Intercalary Remainder—none of which appear in ancient institutions.

sentences.zh: 匏備八音，不可闕數，今已各分太、正、少三等，而閏餘尤無經見，唯《大晟樂書》稱“匏造十三簧者，以象閏餘。

translations.literal: The gourd completes the eight tones and cannot lack a number; now that each has been divided into great, standard, and small grades, Intercalary Remainder especially lacks any classical precedent. Only the Great Sheng Music Treatise says, "When a gourd pipe is made with thirteen reeds, it symbolizes the intercalary remainder.
translations.idiomatic: The gourd completes the eight tones and cannot lack a number; now that each has been divided into great, standard, and small grades, Intercalary Remainder especially lacks any classical precedent. Only the Great Sheng Music Treatise says, "When a gourd pipe is made with thirteen reeds, it symbolizes the intercalary remainder.

sentences.zh: 十者，土之成數；

translations.literal: Ten is the completed number of Earth;
translations.idiomatic: Ten is the completed number of Earth;

sentences.zh: 三者，木之生數；

translations.literal: three is the generating number of Wood;
translations.idiomatic: three is the generating number of Wood;

sentences.zh: 木得土而能生也。

translations.literal: Wood obtaining Earth can then generate."
translations.idiomatic: Wood obtaining Earth can then generate."

sentences.zh: ”故獨用黃鍾一清聲。

translations.literal: Therefore only the one clear tone of Huangzhong is used.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore only the one clear tone of Huangzhong is used.

sentences.zh: 黃鍾清聲，無應閏之理，今去閏餘一匏，止用兩色，仍改避七星、九星之名，止曰七管、九管。

translations.literal: The clear tone of Huangzhong has no reason to correspond to an intercalary month; now the Intercalary Remainder gourd pipe is removed, only two types are used, and the names Seven Stars and Nine Stars are changed— they are simply called seven-pipe and nine-pipe.
translations.idiomatic: The clear tone of Huangzhong has no reason to correspond to an intercalary month; now the Intercalary Remainder gourd pipe is removed, only two types are used, and the names Seven Stars and Nine Stars are changed—they are simply called seven-pipe and nine-pipe.

sentences.zh: 其六，舊制有巢笙、竽笙、和笙。

translations.literal: Sixth, under the old system there were nest sheng, yu sheng, and he sheng.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth, under the old system there were nest sheng, yu sheng, and he sheng.

sentences.zh: 巢笙自黃鍾而下十九管，非古制度。

translations.literal: The nest sheng had nineteen pipes from Huangzhong downward—not an ancient institution.
translations.idiomatic: The nest sheng had nineteen pipes from Huangzhong downward—not an ancient institution.

sentences.zh: 其竽笙、和笙並以正律林鍾為宮，三笙合奏，曲用兩調，和笙奏黃鍾曲，則巢笙奏林鍾曲以應之，宮、徵相雜。

translations.literal: The yu sheng and he sheng both took the correct pitch Linzhong as gong; the three sheng played together, and a piece used two modes—the he sheng played a Huangzhong piece while the nest sheng played a Linzhong piece in response, mixing gong and zhi.
translations.idiomatic: The yu sheng and he sheng both took the correct pitch Linzhong as gong; the three sheng played together, and a piece used two modes—the he sheng played a Huangzhong piece while the nest sheng played a Linzhong piece in response, mixing gong and zhi.

sentences.zh: 器本宴樂，今依鍾磬法，裁十二管以應十二律，為太、正、少三等，其舊笙更不用。

translations.literal: The instruments were originally for banquet music; now, following the chime-bell and chime-stone method, they are trimmed to twelve pipes corresponding to the twelve pitch pipes, in great, standard, and small grades, and the old sheng are no longer used.
translations.idiomatic: The instruments were originally for banquet music; now, following the chime-bell and chime-stone method, they are trimmed to twelve pipes corresponding to the twelve pitch pipes, in great, standard, and small grades, and the old sheng are no longer used.

sentences.zh: 其七，、、晉鼓、鎛鍾、特磬，雖無太、少，係作止和樂，合行備設。

translations.literal: Seventh, the zhu, yu, Jin drum, bo bell, and special stone chime—though without great and small grades—are instruments that mark the beginning and harmonization of music and should all be fully provided.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh, the zhu, yu, Jin drum, bo bell, and special stone chime—though without great and small grades—are instruments that mark the beginning and harmonization of music and should all be fully provided.

sentences.zh: 其八，登歌宮架有搏拊二器，按《虞書》：“戛擊鳴球，搏拊琴瑟。

translations.literal: Eighth, the ascending song and palace orchestral stands have two bofu clappers. According to the Book of Yu: "Strike and tap the sounding spheres; clap the zithers and lutes.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth, the ascending song and palace orchestral stands have two bofu clappers. According to the Book of Yu: "Strike and tap the sounding spheres; clap the zithers and lutes.

sentences.zh: ”王安石解曰：“或戛或擊，或搏或拊。

translations.literal: Wang Anshi explained: "Some are struck, some are tapped; some are clapped, some are patted.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Anshi explained: "Some are struck, some are tapped; some are clapped, some are patted.

sentences.zh: ”與《虞書》所載乖戾。

translations.literal: " This contradicts what the Book of Yu records.
translations.idiomatic: " This contradicts what the Book of Yu records.

sentences.zh: 今欲乞罷而不用。

translations.literal: We now beg to abolish them and not use them.
translations.idiomatic: We now beg to abolish them and not use them.

sentences.zh: 詔悉從之。

translations.literal: An edict fully approved all of this.
translations.idiomatic: An edict fully approved all of this.

sentences.zh: 攸之弟絛曰：

translations.literal: You's younger brother Tiao said:
translations.idiomatic: You's younger brother Tiao said:

sentences.zh: 初，漢津獻說，請帝三指之三寸，三合而為九，為黃鍾之律。

translations.literal: At first, when Hanjin presented his theory, he asked the Emperor for three finger joints of three inches each; three combined made nine, forming the pitch of Huangzhong.
translations.idiomatic: At first, when Hanjin presented his theory, he asked the Emperor for three finger joints of three inches each; three combined made nine, forming the pitch of Huangzhong.

sentences.zh: 又以中指之徑圍為容盛，度量權衡皆自是而出。

translations.literal: He also took the diameter and circumference of the middle finger as the standard of capacity, and measures, weights, and balances all derived from this.
translations.idiomatic: He also took the diameter and circumference of the middle finger as the standard of capacity, and measures, weights, and balances all derived from this.

sentences.zh: 又謂：“有太聲、有少聲。

translations.literal: He also said: "There is a great tone and there is a small tone.
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "There is a great tone and there is a small tone.

sentences.zh: 太者，清聲，陽也，天道也；

translations.literal: The great is the clear tone—it is yang, the Way of Heaven;
translations.idiomatic: The great is the clear tone—it is yang, the Way of Heaven;

sentences.zh: 少者，濁聲，陰也，地道也；

translations.literal: the small is the muddy tone—it is yin, the Way of Earth;
translations.idiomatic: the small is the muddy tone—it is yin, the Way of Earth;

sentences.zh: 中聲，其間，人道也。

translations.literal: the central tone lies between them—it is the Way of Man.
translations.idiomatic: the central tone lies between them—it is the Way of Man.

sentences.zh: 合三才之道，備陰陽之奇偶，然後四序可得而調，萬物可得而理。

translations.literal: Combining the Way of the Three Powers and completing the odd and even of yin and yang, only then can the four seasons be tuned and the myriad things be ordered."
translations.idiomatic: Combining the Way of the Three Powers and completing the odd and even of yin and yang, only then can the four seasons be tuned and the myriad things be ordered."

sentences.zh: ”當時以為迂怪。

translations.literal: At the time this was thought abstruse and strange.
translations.idiomatic: At the time this was thought abstruse and strange.

sentences.zh: 劉昺之兄煒以嘵樂律進，未幾而卒。

translations.literal: Liu Bing's elder brother Wei advanced by discoursing on music theory, and died not long after.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Bing's elder brother Wei advanced by discoursing on music theory, and died not long after.

sentences.zh: 昺始主樂事，乃建白謂：太、少不合儒書。

translations.literal: When Bing first took charge of music affairs, he memorialized saying that the great and small tones did not accord with the Confucian classics.
translations.idiomatic: When Bing first took charge of music affairs, he memorialized saying that the great and small tones did not accord with the Confucian classics.

sentences.zh: 以太史公《書》黃鍾八寸七分琯為中聲，奏之於初氣；

translations.literal: Taking Grand Historian Sima Qian's account of an eight-inch, seven-part Huangzhong pipe as the central tone, to be played at the initial qi;
translations.idiomatic: Taking Grand Historian Sima Qian's account of an eight-inch, seven-part Huangzhong pipe as the central tone, to be played at the initial qi;

sentences.zh: 班固《書》黃鍾九寸琯為正聲，奏之於中氣。

translations.literal: and Ban Gu's account of a nine-inch Huangzhong pipe as the correct tone, to be played at the central qi.
translations.idiomatic: and Ban Gu's account of a nine-inch Huangzhong pipe as the correct tone, to be played at the central qi.

sentences.zh: 因請帝指時止用中指，又不得徑圍為容盛，故後凡製器，不能成劑量，工人但隨律調之，大率有非漢津之本說者。

translations.literal: He therefore asked that only the middle finger be used to establish pitch, and that the diameter and circumference not serve as the standard of capacity; hence afterward, whenever instruments were made, they could not achieve proper measure, and craftsmen simply tuned them according to pitch—generally diverging from Hanjin's original theory.
translations.idiomatic: He therefore asked that only the middle finger be used to establish pitch, and that the diameter and circumference not serve as the standard of capacity; hence afterward, whenever instruments were made, they could not achieve proper measure, and craftsmen simply tuned them according to pitch—generally diverging from Hanjin's original theory.

sentences.zh: 及政和末，明堂成，議欲為布政調燮事，乃召武臣前知憲州任宗堯換朝奉大夫，為大晟府典樂。

translations.literal: By the end of the Zhenghe era, when the Bright Hall was completed, deliberations turned to distributing governance and harmonizing affairs; Ren Zongyao, a former military official who had served as prefect of Xianzhou, was summoned and transferred to Court Gentleman for Meritorious Service as Director of Music of the Great Sheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: By the end of the Zhenghe era, when the Bright Hall was completed, deliberations turned to distributing governance and harmonizing affairs; Ren Zongyao, a former military official who had served as prefect of Xianzhou, was summoned and transferred to Court Gentleman for Meritorious Service as Director of Music of the Great Sheng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 宗堯至，則言：太、少之說本出於古人，雖王樸猶知之，而劉昺不用。

translations.literal: When Zongyao arrived, he said that the theory of great and small tones originally came from the ancients—even Wang Pu still knew it, yet Liu Bing did not use it.
translations.idiomatic: When Zongyao arrived, he said that the theory of great and small tones originally came from the ancients—even Wang Pu still knew it, yet Liu Bing did not use it.

sentences.zh: 乃自創黃鍾為兩律。

translations.literal: He then created Huangzhong as two pitch pipes on his own.
translations.idiomatic: He then created Huangzhong as two pitch pipes on his own.

sentences.zh: 黃鍾，君也，不宜有兩。

translations.literal: Huangzhong is the sovereign and ought not to exist in duplicate.
translations.idiomatic: Huangzhong is the sovereign and ought not to exist in duplicate.

sentences.zh: 蔡攸方提舉大晟府，不喜佗人預樂。

translations.literal: Cai You was then supervising the Great Sheng Prefecture and disliked others interfering in music.
translations.idiomatic: Cai You was then supervising the Great Sheng Prefecture and disliked others interfering in music.

sentences.zh: 有士人田為者，善琵琶，無行，攸乃奏為大晟府典樂，遂不用中聲八寸七分琯，而但用九寸琯。

translations.literal: There was a scholar named Tian Wei who was skilled at the pipa but without proper conduct; You memorialized to make him Director of Music of the Great Sheng Prefecture, and then the central-tone eight-inch, seven-part pipe was not used—only the nine-inch pipe was used.
translations.idiomatic: There was a scholar named Tian Wei who was skilled at the pipa but without proper conduct; You memorialized to make him Director of Music of the Great Sheng Prefecture, and then the central-tone eight-inch, seven-part pipe was not used—only the nine-inch pipe was used.

sentences.zh: 又為一律長尺有八寸，曰太聲；

translations.literal: He also made one pitch pipe one foot and eight inches long, called the great tone;
translations.idiomatic: He also made one pitch pipe one foot and eight inches long, called the great tone;

sentences.zh: 一律長四寸有半，曰少聲：是為三黃鍾律矣。

translations.literal: and one pitch pipe four and a half inches long, called the small tone: thus there were three Huangzhong pitch pipes.
translations.idiomatic: and one pitch pipe four and a half inches long, called the small tone: thus there were three Huangzhong pitch pipes.

sentences.zh: 律與容盛又不翅數倍。

translations.literal: The pitch pipes and the standard of capacity differed by more than several times.
translations.idiomatic: The pitch pipes and the standard of capacity differed by more than several times.

sentences.zh: 黃鍾既四寸有半，則圜鍾幾不及二寸。

translations.literal: Since Huangzhong was four and a half inches, the round bell was scarcely two inches.
translations.idiomatic: Since Huangzhong was four and a half inches, the round bell was scarcely two inches.

sentences.zh: 諸器大小皆隨律，蓋但以器大者為太，小者為少。

translations.literal: The sizes of all instruments followed the pitch pipes; essentially, whichever instrument was larger was called great and whichever was smaller was called small.
translations.idiomatic: The sizes of all instruments followed the pitch pipes; essentially, whichever instrument was larger was called great and whichever was smaller was called small.

sentences.zh: 樂始成，試之於政事堂，執政心知其非，然不敢言，因用之於明堂布政，望鶴愈不至。

translations.literal: When the music was first completed, it was tested in the Hall of Administrative Affairs; the chief ministers knew in their hearts that it was wrong, yet dared not speak. It was therefore used for distributing governance at the Bright Hall, and the hoped-for cranes still did not come.
translations.idiomatic: When the music was first completed, it was tested in the Hall of Administrative Affairs; the chief ministers knew in their hearts that it was wrong, yet dared not speak. It was therefore used for distributing governance at the Bright Hall, and the hoped-for cranes still did not come.

sentences.zh: 絛又曰：“宴樂本雜用唐聲調，樂器多夷部，亦唐律。

translations.literal: Tiao also said: "Banquet music originally mixed Tang modes; the instruments were mostly from foreign departments and also followed Tang pitch standards.
translations.idiomatic: Tiao also said: "Banquet music originally mixed Tang modes; the instruments were mostly from foreign departments and also followed Tang pitch standards.

sentences.zh: 徵、角二調，其均自隋、唐間已亡。

translations.literal: The zhi and jiao modes—their proper scales had already been lost since the Sui and Tang.
translations.idiomatic: The zhi and jiao modes—their proper scales had already been lost since the Sui and Tang.

sentences.zh: 政和初，命大晟府改用大晟律，其聲下唐樂已兩律。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhenghe, the Great Sheng Prefecture was ordered to change to Great Sheng pitch standards; its tones were already two pitch pipes lower than Tang music.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Zhenghe, the Great Sheng Prefecture was ordered to change to Great Sheng pitch standards; its tones were already two pitch pipes lower than Tang music.

sentences.zh: 然劉昺止用所謂中聲八寸七分琯為之，又作匏、笙、塤、篪，皆入夷部。

translations.literal: Yet Liu Bing used only the so-called central-tone eight-inch, seven-part pipe to make them, and also made gourd pipes, sheng, ocarinas, and chi flutes—all entering foreign departments.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Liu Bing used only the so-called central-tone eight-inch, seven-part pipe to make them, and also made gourd pipes, sheng, ocarinas, and chi flutes—all entering foreign departments.

sentences.zh: 至於《徵招》、《角招》，終不得其本均，大率皆假之以見徵音。

translations.literal: As for "Zhi Invitation" and "Jiao Invitation," they never obtained their original scales; for the most part they merely borrowed tones to display zhi notes.
translations.idiomatic: As for "Zhi Invitation" and "Jiao Invitation," they never obtained their original scales; for the most part they merely borrowed tones to display zhi notes.

sentences.zh: 然其曲譜頗和美，故一時盛行於天下，然教坊樂工嫉之如仇。

translations.literal: Yet their scores were quite harmonious and beautiful, and so for a time they flourished throughout the realm—though the Music Office musicians hated them like mortal enemies.
translations.idiomatic: Yet their scores were quite harmonious and beautiful, and so for a time they flourished throughout the realm—though the Music Office musicians hated them like mortal enemies.

sentences.zh: 其後，蔡攸復與教坊用事樂工附會，又上唐譜徵、角二聲，遂再命教坊製曲譜，既成，亦不克行而止。

translations.literal: Later, Cai You again colluded with the Music Office musicians in power, submitted Tang scores for the zhi and jiao tones, and again ordered the Music Office to compose scores; once completed, they still could not be implemented and were abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: Later, Cai You again colluded with the Music Office musicians in power, submitted Tang scores for the zhi and jiao tones, and again ordered the Music Office to compose scores; once completed, they still could not be implemented and were abandoned.

sentences.zh: 然政和《徵招》、《角招》遂傳於世矣。

translations.literal: Yet the Zhenghe "Zhi Invitation" and "Jiao Invitation" were transmitted to the world.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the Zhenghe "Zhi Invitation" and "Jiao Invitation" were transmitted to the world.

sentences.zh: 二年八月，罷大晟府製造所並協律官。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the second year, the Great Sheng Prefecture manufacturing office and the masters of temperament were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the second year, the Great Sheng Prefecture manufacturing office and the masters of temperament were abolished.

sentences.zh: 四年十月，洪州奏豐城縣民鋤地得古鍾，大小九具，狀製奇異，各有篆文。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the fourth year, Hongzhou reported that when the people of Fengcheng County were hoeing fields they unearthed ancient bells—nine pieces large and small, of strange design, each bearing seal-script inscriptions.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the fourth year, Hongzhou reported that when the people of Fengcheng County were hoeing fields they unearthed ancient bells—nine pieces large and small, of strange design, each bearing seal-script inscriptions.

sentences.zh: 驗之《考工記》，其製正與古合。

translations.literal: Checked against the Records of Craftsmen, their design exactly matched the ancient model.
translations.idiomatic: Checked against the Records of Craftsmen, their design exactly matched the ancient model.

sentences.zh: 令樂工擊之，其聲中律之無射。

translations.literal: Musicians were ordered to strike them, and their tones matched the pitch pipe Wuyi.
translations.idiomatic: Musicians were ordered to strike them, and their tones matched the pitch pipe Wuyi.

sentences.zh: 繪圖以聞。

translations.literal: A diagram was painted and submitted to inform the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Illustrations were drawn up and reported to the court.

sentences.zh: 七年十二月，金人敗盟，分兵兩道入，詔革弊事，廢諸局，於是大晟府及教樂所、教坊額外人並罷。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the seventh year the Jurchens broke the treaty and entered in two armies; an edict reformed abuses and abolished various bureaus, and so the Great Sheng Prefecture, the Music Instruction Office, and supernumerary personnel of the Music Office were all discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of year seven the Jin broke the alliance and invaded in two columns. An edict swept away corrupt practices and shut down numerous offices; the Great Sheng Prefecture, the music-teaching bureau, and extra posts at the Music Office were all abolished.

sentences.zh: 靖康二年，金人取汴，凡大樂軒架、樂舞圖、舜文二琴、教坊樂器、樂書、樂章、明堂布政閏月體式、景陽鍾並虡、九鼎皆亡矣。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jingkang the Jurchens took Bian; all the great-music hall frames, dance diagrams, Shun's two patterned zithers, Music Office instruments, music books, hymn texts, Bright Hall intercalary-month governance models, the Splendid Yang Bell with its stands, and the Nine Tripods were lost.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingkang 2 the Jin seized Bian. Gone were the great-music frames, dance charts, Shun's two ceremonial zithers, Music Office instruments, treatises, hymnody, the Bright Hall's intercalary-month ritual forms, the Splendid Yang bell and its racks, and the Nine Tripods.
